arStrings.szText: First things first. I’m sorry. I lost my temper. Said some vile things to you. T'weren't fair. I was ashamed, see. ‘Cause I tried to help, and innocents got hurt.
Same as Donan, same as his Order. I wasn’t wrong to criticize‘em. But I was a fool not to empathize. We fought for the same thing, in the end. Peace.
All that said, I may have found an answer in Elias’ notes. To send something back to Hell, you need to summon something first.
But like needs like. So, to send back Astaroth’s blood...we’d need to summon Astaroth. Only, that’s spittin’ lunacy, isn’t it? Not even the Horadrim would risk that.
